summary: Remove the authored generation strategy; svg is the only generation path. Supersedes the 2026-11-07 freeze of non-SVG modes for authored.
invariants: Phases follow docs/authored-removal-design-20261105.md as refreshed by docs/authored-removal-execution-20261109.md: P1 stop new authored generation, P2 existing decks, P3 authored-only code, P4 database, P5 docs.

Existing authored decks are handled with option A (owner decision 2026-11-10): no snapshot or backup and no grace period; the driver is removed so an authored deck lists as unsupported, opening it returns unsupported_presentation_driver, and delete still works, like removed Template V2 decks.
Shared infrastructure svg depends on (style catalogue, canvas, checkpoints, renderer, master pins) is kept; delete by driver, not by file name.
Persisted and wire literals are never renamed (operation authored_generation, authored_style, style_source authored, driver id literals, AUTHORED_* env names svg reads, authored_slide_checkpoints).
forbidden: Silently substituting another strategy for a request svg cannot serve
Deleting a shared module only because its name contains authored
evidence: Owner instruction 2026-11-10: change existing-deck handling from option C to option A
